dct_creator_sm: McLaren, Jennie R (University of Texas). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2004-4783
dct_description_sm: The dataset involved in this project is a compilation of nearly 20 years of data, on an experiment designed to tease apart bottom up vs. top down controls on understory plants in the Yukon. For the first decade of a factorial experiment, fertilizer was added to half the plots, and snowshoe hare herbivory was excluded. After 10 years, each plot was permanently divided in half where treatment was stopped, so researchers could measure recovery of the communities. The data consists of species richness and percent cover data for nearly 80 species of understory plants at two sites, each with 16 plots.
dct_title_s: Top down vs bottom up control on understory plant community structure in the northern Boreal Forest
